summary: Kong for Startups gives selected early-stage AI/API teams up to $100,000 in Kong Konnect Plus credits, valid 12 months from the date they land in the Konnect org (unused credits do not roll over). Most early-stage startups receive between $25K and $100K upfront. Credits spend across AI Gateway, API Gateway, Metering and Billing, Mesh, and Event Gateway. After credits expire or for usage beyond the balance, accepted startups pay 50% of Konnect Plus list pricing for 24 months. Eligibility: typically pre-seed through Series A, under $10M total funding, in production or launching within 6 months. YC companies are pre-qualified for the full $100K plus the two-year discount. Kong reviews applications (typically within 5 business days); credits land within 24 hours of acceptance. Existing Kong customers who qualify can have their balance increased.
claim_steps: Apply on konghq.com/solutions/startup-program with what you are building and which Kong products you will use (about 5 minutes). YC companies should indicate their batch.
Wait for Kong review (typically within 5 business days).
On acceptance, credits land in your Konnect org within 24 hours; the 50% discount auto-applies on invoices after credits run out.
